rationale: Price has stalled in a very tight, low-volume consolidation at $20.27, sitting right at the 5m 9-EMA ($20.26) but still below session VWAP ($20.35), so the bearish structure that justified the short is still intact and the $20.37 invalidation is not breached. With risk to invalidation (~$0.11) smaller than reward to the $20.07 target (~$0.19) and SPY still weak/VIXY higher, holding the short for continuation is preferable to closing flat or flipping long against VWAP; the stalled momentum is the main reason confidence is only modest.
